bol-pack.name: BOL Pack
bol-pack.description: Assemble a bill-of-lading completeness pack from their BOL PDF, scale export, and NMFC file.

dim-vs-scale-exceptions.name: DIM Versus Scale Exceptions
dim-vs-scale-exceptions.description: Compare carton-size inches to scale-export pounds. Never invent DIM, scale, or billed weight.

end-of-day-manifest.name: End-of-Day Manifest
end-of-day-manifest.description: Compare live label PDFs to the carrier manifest export. Voided labels must not appear as tendered.

hold-and-will-call.name: Hold and Will-Call
hold-and-will-call.description: From the pick or address file, list credit holds, ship-complete holds, hold-for-pickup, and will-call.

pack-exceptions.name: Pack Exceptions
pack-exceptions.description: Compare the pack export to the pick file. List shorts, extras, unknown carton codes, and missing scale weights.

pick-wave.name: Pick / Wave List
pick-wave.description: Build today’s pick list from their pick export. Keep wave ids if they use them; do not invent a wave.

rma-returns.name: RMA / Returns Pack
rma-returns.description: List open RMAs from their sheet. Do not invent an RMA, restock qty, or a customer credit.

short-ship-list.name: Short-Ship List
short-ship-list.description: From pick versus pack, list orders where packed qty is less than ordered or picked qty they still wanted.

tracking-exceptions.name: Tracking Exceptions
tracking-exceptions.description: From the carrier export, list exception codes, failed delivery, and trackers that never appeared after a label PDF.
